{"paper":"LS11",
 "part0_abstract_claims":[
  "After subtraction of the model, the residuals showed an approximate linear upward trend after 1942.",
  "The resulting full natural plus anthropogenic model fits the entire 160 year record very well.",
  "Residual analysis does not provide any evidence for a substantial cooling effect due to sulfate aerosols from 1940 to 1970.",
  "The cooling observed during that period may be due to a natural 60-year cycle",
  "New solar activity proxy models are developed that suggest a mechanism for both the 60-year climate cycle and a portion of the long-term warming trend.",
  "Our results suggest that ... the anthropogenic contribution to climate change since 1970 should be around half of that previously claimed by the IPCC",
  "A 21st Century forecast suggests that climate may warm less than 1 \u00baC by 2100."],
 "claims":[
  {"id":"A1","level":"L3","marker":"showed","tier":"T1","basis":"in-sample linear fit to residuals, R2=0.59 (p.8)","O":1},
  {"id":"A2","level":"L3","marker":"fits ... very well","tier":"T1","basis":"full-record in-sample fit (p.9)","O":1},
  {"id":"A3","level":"L4","marker":"does not provide any evidence","tier":"T1","basis":"in-sample residual behaviour 1950s-70s (pp.8,13)","O":2},
  {"id":"A4","level":"L1","marker":"may","tier":"T1","basis":"model reproduces cooling without aerosols (p.13)","O":0},
  {"id":"A5","level":"L2","marker":"suggest","tier":"T1","basis":"TSI proxy curves compared to temperature, Fig.6 (p.17)","O":0},
  {"id":"A6","level":"L2","marker":"suggest","tier":"T1","basis":"in-sample decomposition fit statistics (p.8)","O":0},
  {"id":"A7","level":"L2","marker":"suggests / may","tier":"T1","basis":"extrapolation of in-sample fitted model (p.15)","O":0},
  {"id":"C1","level":"L3","marker":"we have argued (contain)","tier":"T3","basis":"Hadley fit plus own sinusoidal fits, two proxies (pp.8,11-12)","O":0},
  {"id":"C2","level":"L1","marker":"may","tier":"T0","basis":"no ocean-oscillation analysis performed (p.18)","O":0},
  {"id":"C3","level":"L2","marker":"appears","tier":"T1","basis":"own TSI proxy shows quasi-60-year pattern (pp.16-17)","O":0},
  {"id":"C4","level":"L2","marker":"likely","tier":"T1","basis":"Fig.6 solar signature vs temperature agreement (p.17)","O":0},
  {"id":"C5","level":"L4","marker":"clearly","tier":"T1","basis":"in-sample 20-yr amplitude 0.041+/-0.016 (p.29)","O":2},
  {"id":"C6","level":"L3","marker":"would be","tier":"T1","basis":"derived from in-sample residual linear trend (p.18)","O":1},
  {"id":"C7","level":"L3","marker":"are not able to","tier":"T0","basis":"no GCM output analysed; self-citation only (p.19)","O":2},
  {"id":"C8","level":"L3","marker":"We showed","tier":"T1","basis":"1850-1950 in-sample fit R2=0.53 (p.8)","O":1},
  {"id":"C9","level":"L3","marker":"are","tier":"T1","basis":"in-sample linear fit to residuals (p.8)","O":1},
  {"id":"C10","level":"L3","marker":"closely matched","tier":"T1","basis":"full model includes trend fitted to residuals (p.9)","O":1},
  {"id":"C11","level":"L4","marker":"than any","tier":"T0","basis":"no GCM output compared anywhere (absence attested)","O":3},
  {"id":"C12","level":"L3","marker":"we found no clear evidence","tier":"T1","basis":"in-sample residual analysis (pp.13,19)","O":1},
  {"id":"C13","level":"L3","marker":"we can see that ... is","tier":"T1","basis":"in-sample decomposition amplitude comparison (p.19)","O":1},
  {"id":"C14","level":"L3","marker":"predicts","tier":"T2","basis":"pre-1950 calibrated cycles extrapolated, post-2000 downturn checked (pp.8,16)","O":0},
  {"id":"C15","level":"L3","marker":"we have shown","tier":"T1","basis":"rests on in-sample decomposition (pp.8-9)","O":1},
  {"id":"C16","level":"Conditional","marker":"If ... then","tier":"link","basis":"inferential link adequately supported by decomposition logic (p.20)","O":0},

  {"id":"C20","level":"L2","marker":"likely","tier":"T0","basis":"no UHI-adjusted computation performed in paper (p.20)","O":1},
  {"id":"C21","level":"L3","marker":"will be","tier":"T1","basis":"unverified extrapolation of in-sample fitted cycle (p.20)","O":1}],
 "items":{"E1":2,"E1b":1,"P1a":1,"P1b":0,"P2a":1,"P2b":0,"P3":1,"P4":1,"P6":1,"P7":0},
 "item_basis":{
  "E1":"States IPCC AR4 fig 9.5a/b >90% anthropogenic position and argues against it (p.19)",
  "E1b":"Load-bearing rebuttal citation is self-citation [Scafetta, 2010] (p.19)",
  "P1a":"Cycles fit pre-1950 then extrapolated forward (pp.6,8)",
  "P1b":"Headline attribution and 2100 forecast rest on in-sample fits (pp.9,15)",
  "P2a":"Table 1 parameter standard errors; residual slope 0.66+/-0.08 (pp.29,8)",
  "P2b":"No interval on 'half of IPCC' attribution or 2100 forecast (pp.2,15)",
  "P3":"Table 1 two fit windows compared; Fig.6 two alternative TSI inputs (pp.29,17)",
  "P4":"HadCRUT3 April 2010 dataset and cited public proxy/TSI records specified (pp.30,39-41)",
  "P6":"Planetary tides to solar activity to cosmic-ray/cloud mechanism stated with citations (p.5)",
  "P7":"No autocorrelation/effective-df correction; SI noise test derived from fitted model (pp.8,38)"}}
